{"version":"2b1","blocks":[{"type":"text","text":"This interactive weighted comparison evaluates three technologies: Native Hybrid, Tauri, and Electron, based on three criteria: native experience, lightweight runtime, and delivery efficiency. Adjust the weights for each criterion to see how the overall scores and rankings change. Scores are synthetic and fixed per technology."},{"type":"ui","source":"NativeHybrid = [9,8,7]
Tauri = [7,8,8]
Electron = [6,4,10]

weights = [$weight_native, $weight_light, $weight_delivery]

sum_weights = weights[0] + weights[1] + weights[2]

normalized_weights = sum_weights == 0 ? [0,0,0] : [weights[0]/sum_weights, weights[1]/sum_weights, weights[2]/sum_weights]

score_NativeHybrid = @Sum([NativeHybrid[0]*normalized_weights[0], NativeHybrid[1]*normalized_weights[1], NativeHybrid[2]*normalized_weights[2]])
score_Tauri = @Sum([Tauri[0]*normalized_weights[0], Tauri[1]*normalized_weights[1], Tauri[2]*normalized_weights[2]])
score_Electron = @Sum([Electron[0]*normalized_weights[0], Electron[1]*normalized_weights[1], Electron[2]*normalized_weights[2]])

all_zero = sum_weights == 0

scores_table = all_zero ? [] : [
  {label: "Native Hybrid", score: score_NativeHybrid},
  {label: "Tauri", score: score_Tauri},
  {label: "Electron", score: score_Electron}
]

sorted_scores = @Sort(scores_table, "score", "desc")

ranked_labels = all_zero ? [] : [
  "1. " + sorted_scores[0].label + ": " + string(sorted_scores[0].score),
  "2. " + sorted_scores[1].label + ": " + string(sorted_scores[1].score),
  "3. " + sorted_scores[2].label + ": " + string(sorted_scores[2].score)
]

Names start with ASCII letter, then alphanumeric or underscore, at most 48 characters. All declarations must be reachable. Text and labels at most 512 characters. Safe Graphic items use kind plus only required fields: rect(x,y,width,height), circle(cx,cy,r), text(x,y,text), path(d using only M L H V Z, lowercase equivalents, numbers, spaces or commas), group(items of leaves). Numeric coordinates 0..640; viewBox 0 0 450 135.
One assignment per physical line. root = Stack([leafName, otherLeaf]). Each leaf is one named call: Text("text"), Metric("label",numericValue), Control("label",literalMin,literalMax,choices,$variable), Table([{label:"name",score:number}]), Graphic("label",items). Declare $variable = integer and bind it to exactly one Control. Use [] for range or literal string options indexed 0..n-1. Derived name = expression. Strings use double quotes. Numeric + - * /, == > <, condition ? yes : no, arrays, objects, named references, @Sum(numbers), @Sort(rows,"score","desc") are allowed. {"version":"2b1","blocks":[{"type":"text","text":"This interactive weighted comparison evaluates three technologies: Native Hybrid, Tauri, and Electron, based on three criteria: native experience, lightweight runtime, and delivery efficiency. Adjust the weights for each criterion to see how the overall scores and rankings change. Scores are synthetic and fixed per technology."},{"type":"ui","source":"NativeHybrid = [9,8,7]
Tauri = [7,8,8]
Electron = [6,4,10]

weights = [$weight_native, $weight_light, $weight_delivery]
sum_weights = weights[0] + weights[1] + weights[2]
normalized_weights = sum_weights == 0 ? [0,0,0] : [weights[0]/sum_weights, weights[1]/sum_weights, weights[2]/sum_weights]

score_NativeHybrid = @Sum([NativeHybrid[0]*normalized_weights[0], NativeHybrid[1]*normalized_weights[1], NativeHybrid[2]*normalized_weights[2]])
score_Tauri = @Sum([Tauri[0]*normalized_weights[0], Tauri[1]*normalized_weights[1], Tauri[2]*normalized_weights[2]])
score_Electron = @Sum([Electron[0]*normalized_weights[0], Electron[1]*normalized_weights[1], Electron[2]*normalized_weights[2]])

all_zero = sum_weights == 0

scores_table = all_zero ? [] : [
  {label: "Native Hybrid", score: score_NativeHybrid},
  {label: "Tauri", score: score_Tauri},
  {label: "Electron", score: score_Electron}
]

sorted_scores = @Sort(scores_table, "score", "desc")

ranked_labels = all_zero ? ["No ranking: all weights are zero."] : [
  "1. " + sorted_scores[0].label + ": " + string(sorted_scores[0].score),
  "2. " + sorted_scores[1].label + ": " + string(sorted_scores[1].score),
  "3. " + sorted_scores[2].label + ": " + string(sorted_scores[2].score)
]


Control("Native Experience Weight",0,100,[], $weight_native)
Control("Lightweight Runtime Weight",0,100,[], $weight_light)
Control("Delivery Efficiency Weight",0,100,[], $weight_delivery)

Text("Normalized Weights:")
Text("Native Experience: " + string(normalized_weights[0]))
Text("Lightweight Runtime: " + string(normalized_weights[1]))
Text("Delivery Efficiency: " + string(normalized_weights[2]))

Text("Scores per Technology:")
Text("Native Hybrid: " + (all_zero ? "N/A" : string(score_NativeHybrid)))
Text("Tauri: " + (all_zero ? "N/A" : string(score_Tauri)))
Text("Electron: " + (all_zero ? "N/A" : string(score_Electron)))

Text("Ranking:")
Text(ranked_labels[0])
ranked_labels.length > 1 ? Text(ranked_labels[1]) : Text("")
ranked_labels.length > 2 ? Text(ranked_labels[2]) : Text("")
","state":[{"name":"weight_native","value":40},{"name":"weight_light","value":25},{"name":"weight_delivery","value":35}]}]}
